props.title: Hollow Man

sections.content: Hollow Man represents Paul Verhoeven's twisted take on H.G. Wells' "The Invisible Man," amplifying the voyeuristic horror and ethical decay of its source material. Like Verhoeven's earlier sci-fi works RoboCop (1987) and Total Recall (1990), it uses cutting-edge effects to explore how technology corrupts human nature. The film's groundbreaking CGI from Sony Pictures Imageworks revolutionized the visualization of invisibility, showing Sebastian Caine's transformation through layers of anatomy - a technical achievement that holds up decades later.

sections.content: The invisible man subgenre has consistently reflected society's anxieties about surveillance and power. While The Invisible Man (2020) reframes the story through domestic abuse and gaslighting, Hollow Man taps into millennial fears about unchecked scientific advancement. Sebastian's deteriorating morality mirrors films like Ex Machina (2014) and Upgrade (2018), where technological enhancement leads to psychological horror.

Verhoeven's signature blend of social commentary and graphic content puts Hollow Man in conversation with other millennium-era body horror like Existenz (1999) and The Cell (2000). The film's exploration of male gaze and predatory behavior feels especially relevant post-#MeToo, though its treatment of female characters remains problematic by modern standards. SUBHEAD: Visual Effects Legacy

movies.title: Ex Machina
movies.slug: A programmer participates in an experiment evaluating the human qualities of a highly advanced artificial intelligence.

sections.content: The film's Oscar-nominated visual effects by Scott Anderson set new standards for digital character animation. The sequence showing Sebastian's transformation - from skin to muscles to organs to skeleton - influenced countless subsequent films including X-Men (2000) and The Matrix Reloaded (2003). While modern invisibility effects in films like The Invisible Man (2020) focus on practical approaches, Hollow Man's ambitious digital effects work marked a turning point in CGI capability.
